comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts a robot-axis shock absorber; pr-1837 clips a pulse oximeter fully onto a manikin’s index finger without dragging the hand.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses a hex key, counterhold, fine collar rotation, and iterative test cycles. pr-1837 squeezes and holds a spring clip open, aligns and slides it over a finger, releases it to clamp, and steadies a loose hand bimanually.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two non-bottoming, non-overloaded stops with no drift. pr-1837 requires the correctly oriented clip seated near its finger stop, clamped and released, with the hand within displacement limits; excessive hand motion or a fallen device zeros the trial.
comparison.reason: Spring-clip placement on a supported target tests sustained aperture control and insertion, whereas the candidate tests adjustable damping and retained calibration.
